dedupe_keys.name: international air traffic and passengers by month

description: International Air Traffic and Passengers by Month is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Oman Air Traffic and Passengers at Muscat International Airport by Month for 2009-2023. Data from National Center for Statistics and Information, Sultanate of Oman air traffic, Export API data for more datasets to advance energy economics research. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are air traffic, ITEM. The portal shows 2023-12-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
